description: No sign-in needed. Search which apps/services (Telegram, WhatsApp, Google, OpenAI…) have virtual numbers in stock, by country, with the price in Ucode credits. Use this first whenever someone asks for a number or a price. Then: signed-in humans rent with ucode_sms_rent_packages → ucode_sms_rent_with_credits; autonomous agents use ucode_agent_buy_credits / ucode_agent_rent.

country.description: Optional country name or ISO code filter, e.g. 'United Kingdom' or 'gb'

search.description: App or service name, e.g. telegram, whatsapp, openai

name: ucode_find_numbers
title: Find numbers & prices (no login)
